component.name: PhotoSelect Desktop
component.summary: High-speed photo culling and RAW+JPG digital asset management platform

description.p: PhotoSelect Desktop is a lightning-fast photo culling and digital asset management application designed for commercial photographers, wildlife/bird watchers, wedding photographers, and creators.

ul.li: Zero-Import Architecture: Open local folders or SD cards instantly with zero lag.
Smart RAW+JPG Pairing: Automatically pairs RAW with corresponding JPEG/XMP files.
Millisecond Burst Clustering: Sub-second timestamp clustering and best shot recommendation.
Visual Similarity & Dedup: Perceptual hash (dHash) grouping and duplicate detection.
Narrative 100% Eye AF Inspection: Powered by local MediaPipe offline inference.
Hardware Accelerated Darkroom: WebGL 2.0 focus peaking shader and tone mapping.
Adobe Lightroom Classic Compatible: Reads and generates standard XMP sidecar metadata.
